## Identity
Diamond Pads Factory is the official digital brand operated by **Quanzhou Kaiyi Industry & Trade Co., Ltd.** We are a Tier-1 industrial manufacturer and exporter specializing in concrete surface prep, stone polishing, and premium diamond tooling architectures.

## Engineering & Quality Standards
- **Thermal Stability:** Resin bond systems are factory-tested for integrity up to 180°C (356°F).
- **Grit Precision:** All manufacturing sequences are calibrated to ISO 9136 grit standards for predictable scratch patterns.
- **Bonding Systems:** Proprietary Resin, Metal Matrix, Ceramic, and Hybrid Bond architectures.
